Job Title- Client Implementation Analyst, AYST

Location- Mumbai, India

Role Description

How we'll support you

We are looking for fresh graduates who are enthusiastic about developing AI/ML/GenAI applications that work with natural language, speech, and video data. As part of our AI development team, youll contribute to the design and deployment of smart systems using cutting-edge technologies in LLM, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Speech Recognition, Computer Vision and Generative AI.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in developing AI/ML models for processing text, voice, and video data.

  • Basic knowledge of NLP, Speech Processing or Computer Vision techniques.

  • Good communication skills and eagerness to learn and contribute in a team environment.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

This role is for our own content - the work that goes out under our name, not client delivery. You will turn that capability into a relentless stream of video.

Responsibilities

  • Create at volume. Produce a steady, high-output stream of short-form video for Instagram and YouTube - hooks, reels, shorts, edits and trend-led pieces.
  • Edit to a high bar. Bring genuine craft to every cut: pacing, motion, sound design and the finishing details that separate "made with AI" from "made well."
  • Master the toolbox. Work fluently across the AI creative stack, and know the real differences between tools so you always reach for the right one.
  • Own the output. Take ideas from concept to storyboard to generation to final edit to publish - independently, and fast.
  • Set the standard. Study what makes the best content in the world work, and hold our channels to that bar.

What youll bring

  • A standout portfolio that proves your taste and range - your work speaks louder than any r sum .
  • Real editing craft in tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Deep, hands-on fluency with AI creative tools - you know the Indian and global model landscape and, more importantly, how they differ.
  • A sharp instinct for what performs on Instagram and YouTube - hooks, pacing, retention, and why things trend.
  • Speed, ownership and hunger. You would rather ship ten things this week than plan one for next month.
  • Bonus: you already run your own social account with real engagement, or you are comfortable on camera / directing talent.

The tools youll work with

  • Video generation: Veo, Kling, Seedance, Runway, Luma, Hailuo, Pika - and hubs like fal, Krea and Higgsfield
  • AI UGC actors: Arcads, Creatify, HeyGen, Captions
  • Image enhancement: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram, Adobe Firefly; upscaling with Topaz and Magnific
  • Voice audio: ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, Suno
  • Editing post: Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut
  • And, of course: HexCoded

Work details

  • Gurgaon
  • Hours overlapping India and the US, because we build for both markets.

Youll work closely with our Salesforce development team - a mix of Architects, Developers, and Admins - collaborating directly with them to validate changes, reproduce defects, and coordinate test cycles.

Responsibilities

  • Revenue Cloud Advanced testing - validating Product Discovery / Browse Products flows, pricing logic, and configurator behaviour, including a custom LWC replacing the standard flow-based UI
  • Regression testing - across sandboxes as new features and bug fixes are deployed (e.g. validating fixes to LWC/connector issues, pricebook and pricing behaviour)
  • Integration testing - for the Salesforce and Dynamics 365 data flows (batch syncs via Microsoft Fabric/ADF, and event-driven flows via Platform Events/CDC to Azure Service Bus to D365)
  • Configuration validation - sharing rules, validation rules, flow orchestration (including mobile approval flows), campaign/campaign-member setups, and permission/profile changes
  • Test case documentation - writing and maintaining test scripts, tracking defects, and clearly documenting reproduction steps for developers
  • UAT support - helping coordinate or execute user acceptance testing cycles with business stakeholders

What Were Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on QA/testing experience, with at least 1-2 years testing Salesforce specifically
  • Comfortable navigating Salesforce Setup, sandboxes, and basic configuration concepts (objects, flows, validation rules, sharing models)
  • Experience writing structured test cases/scripts and tracking defects (Jira or similar)
  • Strong written communication - youll often be documenting bugs for a small, fast-moving team rather than a large QA org

":" About Jetbro

We are looking for an Elixir Developer to join our team building backend services for scalable, production-grade applications. This is not a role where you simply execute PRDs. Instead, you will be a business-minded engineer who deeply understands the product use cases, business objectives, and strategic implications of technical decisions.

You will design and extend backend services using the Ash Framework, working across resources, actions, and data layers to ship features fast without sacrificing correctness. Our backend is Elixir/Phoenix with Ash as the core application framework, backed by PostgreSQL, deployed on Fly.io. You will spend most of your time inside Ashs resource-oriented patterns rather than hand-rolling boilerplate.

This is a framework-deep role with a business-first mindset. You will actively collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and leadership to understand the why behind features, ask clarifying questions, and contribute to strategic technical decisions. You will use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as everyday tools, and youll also work hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) to build AI-powered features, not just use AI to write code. We expect you to be proficient with them, not just familiar.

  • Ask critical questions about business impact, trade-offs, and long-term implications of technical decisions

            • Database design, query optimization, and migrations in PostgreSQL

            • Deployment, release management, and scaling on Fly.io
            • Production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning

Computational Aeroelasticity Software Developer

Cadence Design Systems is seeking a highly motivated Computational Aeroelasticity Software Developer to contribute to the development of next-generation aeroelastic and aerothermoelastic simulation technologies spanning subsonic through hypersonic flight applications. This role is ideal for a recent Ph. D. graduate, postdoctoral researcher, or early-career engineer with research experience in computational aeroelasticity, multidisciplinary simulation, scientific computing, or related fields.

Key Responsibilities

Computational Aeroelasticity & Aerothermoelasticity Development

Contribute to the development, verification, validation, and deployment of advanced aeroelastic simulation capabilities, including:

Low-Fidelity Methods

  • Panel methods, Doublet Lattice Method (DLM), and Vortex Lattice Method (VLM)
  • Generalized aerodynamic force generation
  • Linearized and frequency-domain aerodynamic modeling

Medium-Fidelity Methods

  • Hybrid CFD-panel methodologies
  • Reduced-order and surrogate modeling
  • Transonic correction techniques
  • Time-domain aeroelastic formulations
  • Flexible vehicle dynamic simulation methods

High-Fidelity Methods

  • CFD-based aeroelasticity using Euler and Navier-Stokes solvers
  • Fluid-structure interaction (FSI) and CFD-CSD coupling
  • Nonlinear aeroelasticity and aerothermoelasticity
  • High-speed and hypersonic aeroelastic analysis

Support the development of solutions for:

  • Static and dynamic aeroelasticity
  • Flutter prediction
  • Divergence and control reversal
  • Gust response and aeroservoelasticity
  • Buffet response and limit-cycle oscillations
  • Nonlinear aeroelastic behavior

Work with senior technical staff to transition advanced research concepts into production-quality commercial software.

Hypersonic & High-Speed Flight Simulation

Contribute to the development of simulation technologies for high-speed and hypersonic vehicle applications, including:

  • Hypersonic aerodynamics and aerothermodynamics
  • Shock-wave/boundary-layer interactions
  • Thermal-structural coupling and aerothermoelasticity
  • High-temperature flight environments
  • Flight stability and control at high Mach numbers

  • Piston theory
  • Supersonic and hypersonic aerodynamic methods
  • Shock-expansion techniques
  • Reduced-order models
  • CFD-based aeroelastic methodologies

Prior research experience in one or more of these areas is highly desirable.

Multidisciplinary Simulation & Structural Dynamics

Collaborate with structural dynamics, CFD, and multiphysics development teams to build integrated simulation workflows.

Contribute to:

  • Modal analysis and structural dynamics
  • Dynamic response analysis
  • Eigenvalue extraction methods
  • Coupled aerodynamic-structural simulations
  • Thermal stress and buckling analyses
  • Large-scale finite element modeling

Support applications involving:

  • Commercial and military aircraft
  • Rotorcraft and UAVs
  • Hypersonic vehicles
  • Space and launch systems
  • Advanced aerospace and defense platforms

Scientific Software Development

Develop robust and scalable commercial software capabilities, including:

  • Numerical algorithms and solver development
  • Scientific software architecture
  • APIs and workflow automation
  • Multiphysics integration frameworks
  • Verification and validation methodologies
  • Automated testing and continuous integration practices

Participate in the full software development lifecycle from research prototype to commercial product deployment.

High-Performance Computing

Contribute to the development and optimization of scalable simulation technologies using:

  • Parallel computing concepts
  • MPI, OpenMP, GPU, or accelerator technologies
  • Cloud and distributed computing environments

Optimize algorithms for large-scale engineering simulations and advanced aerospace workflows. Prior experience is beneficial but not required.

Customer & Industry Engagement

Work with technical experts, product teams, and customers to:

  • Understand aerospace simulation requirements

Description :

Alice.io (formerly known as ActiveFence) is a leading trust, safety, and security company. Just like Alice herself, we go down the rabbit hole into the emerging world of AI and focus on safeguarding these technologies. In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice offers coverage across the entire AI lifecycle.

We're currently on the ground floor of an exciting new initiative : The Alice Collective - an elite network of the world's premier cyber specialists focused on high-stakes, project-based work for the "best of the best" red-teamers in the industry.

Work is on-demand and project-dependent, scaling up and down based on the needs of the clients. This is not a high-volume, repetitive role; it is an opportunity to be tapped for specific, high-impact interventions when your unique expertise is required and to create a source of secondary income.

The most sophisticated technology challenges in the world are waiting down the rabbit hole. Were looking for the sharpest minds to help us secure the frontier.

The invitation is open : Come join us at the tea party.

About the position :

As one of Alices Security Red Team Specialist freelancers, you'll focus on Generative AI Models. You will play a critical role in enhancing the security and integrity of our cutting-edge AI technologies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct analysis and testing of our generative AI systems, including but not limited to language models, image generation models, and any related infrastructure.

Your objective is to help clients secure their AI models and frameworks by identifying weaknesses, assessing risks, and providing clear steps for improvement.

Key Responsibilities :

- Simulated Cyber Attacks : Conduct sophisticated and comprehensive simulated attacks on generative AI models and their operating environments to uncover vulnerabilities.

- Vulnerability Assessment : Evaluate the security posture of AI models and infrastructure, identifying weaknesses and potential threats.

- Mitigation Strategies : Collaborate with development and security teams to develop effective strategies to mitigate identified risks and enhance model resilience.

- Research and Innovation : Stay abreast of the latest trends and developments in AI security, ethical hacking, and cyber threats. Apply innovative testing methodologies to ensure cutting-edge security practices.

- Documentation and Reporting : Maintain detailed documentation of all red team activities, findings, and recommendations. Prepare and present reports to senior management and relevant stakeholders.

Requirements :

Must-Have :

- Proven experience in AI vulnerabilities analysis

- Strong understanding of AI technologies and their underlying architectures, especially generative models and agentic frameworks.

- At Least 5 years of experience in Web Penetration testing.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

Nice-to-Have :

- Proficiency in Python or NodeJS

- Advanced Certifications in offensive cybersecurity (e.g. OSWE, OSCE3, SEC542, SEC522) are highly desirable.

- Familiarity with agentic frameworks and agentic development experience

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

- Proven records for vulnerability disclosure, such as CVE

All applicants will be required to complete a screening exam and background check.

jobDescription:
We are hiring an Operations & Events Executive to help run the day-to-day of an established organisation in the international education sector, and to own the delivery of its events.


This is a hands-on ownership role. We run a calendar of programmes, awards, summits, roundtables and student events across India and the UK, we work with a large number of universities, and we have a community of members and volunteers spread across the country. Much of it currently depends on personal effort and individual follow-up, and this role exists to turn that into an operation that runs to a system, and to deliver the set-piece events to a real standard.


This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates from anywhere.


Working hours Monday to Friday: 9am to 6pm UK time.

Saturday: 9am to 1:30pm UK time.


The Role: AI-native, used centrally throughout


You will:

  • Help own the operating calendar across every programme and event
  • Be part of the team day to day: set the rhythm, run the check-ins, hold people to a standard
  • Help own the set-piece events end to end: planning, suppliers, venues, budgets, run sheets, and the delivery itself, directing the on-ground coordinators and volunteers who deliver in person.
  • Coordinate volunteer and ambassador network that delivers much of what happens
  • Keep every workstream moving, projects, partnerships, events and community, and always be able to say what is on track, what is at risk, and what needs a decision.
  • Turn recurring work into process: SOPs, trackers and tooling, so the second run takes half the effort of the first.
  • Help own budgets and spend across operations and events: what was approved, what was spent, and why they differ.
  • Manage suppliers and contracts, and hold them to what they agreed.
  • Report upwards clearly and without being asked, and take work and decisions off the leadership as trust builds.
  • Use AI across your workflow: planning, drafting, tracking, reporting, automation and beyond.

What we're looking for

  • Experience across operations, programme management and event delivery
  • Proven event delivery: you have personally helped produced significant events end to end, including run sheets.
  • Able to deliver at a distance, through people on the ground, without losing control of the detail.
  • Highly organised in practice, not in description: nothing dropped, everything tracked, follow-up without a reminder.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with building the structure yourself. There is no finished playbook.
  • The ceiling and the appetite to grow into running the whole operation.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Much of the coordination is written, and much of it is with senior people.
  • Genuine, demonstrable fluency with AI tools as part of how you work, with concrete examples.
  • Comfortable working fully remote, to UK hours, with high autonomy.

Nice to have

  • Experience running or coordinating volunteers, ambassadors, chapters or a member community.
  • Experience in the education, student, non-profit, membership body or association sector.
  • Content Creation/Digital Marketing/Social Media Experience
  • Conference or summit production, awards, or sponsor-funded events.
  • Having built an operating model rather than only running an existing one.
  • Automation and tooling: Notion, Airtable, n8n, Zapier, or AI-driven workflows.

jobDescription:
Role Purpose


The Analyst Supply Solutions is responsible for delivering accurate and timely purchase order execution while elevating the function from transactional processing to AI-enabled, data-driven decision support. The role combines operational discipline, strong analytical judgment, and practical program management to improve service levels, reduce delays, and solve supplier-facing execution risks at scale.


What Success Looks Like

  • Order cycles run on time with high transaction quality and clear exception ownership.
  • Teams receive proactive, insight-led recommendations rather than passive status reporting.
  • Supplier delay risks are identified early, triaged correctly, and resolved through structured action plans.
  • AI and automation improve speed, consistency, and quality of operational decisions.
  • Cross-functional governance is reliable, transparent, and outcome-focused.

Core Responsibilities

A. Operational Execution and Control

  • Execute weekly ordering for replenishment and non-replenishment purchase orders with strong data accuracy.
  • Manage the PO lifecycle, including revisions, status tracking, exception logging, and issue closure.
  • Coordinate supply chain interruption updates (for example: factory constraints, shipment slippages, and recovery plans).
  • Publish concise progress updates for business stakeholders with clear decisions, actions, and ownership.
  • Maintain SOPs and control documents with disciplined versioning and audit readiness.

B. AI and Advanced Analytics (Mandatory)

  • Analyze demand, forecast, and order signals to detect outliers, risk clusters, and recurring root causes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools responsibly for anomaly detection, prioritization logic, and insight generation.
  • Develop practical analytical frameworks to separate urgent exceptions from low-impact noise.
  • Convert complex analysis into simple business narratives for planners, merchants, and leadership teams.
  • Build scalable KPI views and dashboards that improve action speed and accountability.
  • Measure and communicate impact of AI and automation using baseline-versus-outcome metrics.

C. Supply Solutions (Mandatory)

  • Lead structured problem-solving for supplier delay scenarios, from detection to closure.
  • Run cross-functional action plans with sourcing, planning, logistics, and supplier partners to recover at-risk orders.
  • Define and track delay recovery playbooks, including alternatives such as re-prioritization, partial allocation, and timeline resets.
  • Create and maintain early-warning indicators for supplier performance and delivery risk.
  • Drive weekly risk reviews with clear escalations, dependency management, and decision logs.
  • Recommend systemic fixes that reduce repeat delay patterns and improve planning reliability.

D. Collaboration and Capability Building

  • Partner with product and technology teams to design, test, and deploy process improvements.
  • Coach team members on structured analytics, data interpretation, and exception triage methods.
  • Ensure compliance with policies, data quality standards, and responsible AI usage principles.

Added Advantage: Apparel and Fashion Domain Knowledge

  • Understanding of apparel and fashion supply chain dynamics, including seasonality, lead-time sensitivity, and style-level variability.
  • Awareness of fashion lifecycle constraints such as launch windows, trend-driven demand shifts, and markdown risk.
  • Ability to interpret supplier and capacity constraints in the context of apparel and fashion planning cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 4-6 years of relevant experience in order management, supply chain, retail, CPG, or a similar environment.
  • Advanced Excel and strong working knowledge of SQL for analysis, validation, and insight generation.
  • Demonstrated analytical strength in framing hypotheses, identifying root causes, and driving actions.
  • Strong stakeholder communication and program-tracking skills in cross-functional environments.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
  • Experience applying AI-enabled methods in operations, planning, or analytics.
  • Experience in supplier performance programs and delay recovery governance.

About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
    • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony )
    • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages ( AgriLokal )
    • Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs )
    • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )
    • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.
We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
Role Overview :
We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Marathi -speaking) to support Lokal App s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets.
You ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact.
Responsibilities
  • Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal Apps services.
  • Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system.
  • Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.
  • Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.
  • Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App.
  • Fluency in Marathi and a good command of English .
  • Previous experience in tele sales or sales roles is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus.
  • Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales.
  • Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum).
Why Join Us
We re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

About Us
We re Bolt.new by StackBlitz!
We re the team that brought you WebContainers, the first-of-its-kind technology that made it possible to run Node.js right inside your browser. That breakthrough kicked off our journey in 2019, and it s what powers the blazing-fast online IDE used by over 1 million developers every month.
But we didn t stop there. We doubled down on everything we learned and built Bolt.new - the fastest way to go from idea to production without writing traditional code. It s a next-gen, AI-powered app builder that helps you create, edit, and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps instantly, right in your browser. No installs. No setup. Just smart automation and instant dev environments that let you move at the speed of thought.
We re a fully remote team, globally distributed, deeply collaborative, and seriously passionate about building the future of software development.
This is your chance to join a small team with a big vision. If you love shipping fast, solving real problems, and pushing the boundaries of what s possible, we d love to meet you.
About This Opportunity
Bolt is a product made of language. People describe what they want in words, an agent builds it, and they judge the result without ever reading the code. That makes our words load-bearing in a way they arent in most products. It also means theres real craft available in nearly every surface, because weve grown fast and written as we go. Nobody is ahead of you in deciding what great looks like.
Youll be the first content designer at Bolt, and the job has two halves.
Own content as a discipline. Define the standard: the voice, the patterns, the vocabulary, and the reasons behind them. Then raise the bar on everyone elses words, most of which come from people who arent designers. Your value here is leverage, not volume. Success looks like PMs and engineers writing better content without you in the room.
Ship content-led features end to end, on your own. Not on day one. We have real content debt, and your first months go to the standard. After that, this becomes the other half of the job: feature onboarding, in-product education, the moments where a value prop has to land. Nobody is assigned to turn your thinking into screens. Youre the design DRI, in Figma or with agentic tools, through to shipped.
We move fast, and the problems are ambiguous. If the second half reads as daunting rather than fun, this isnt your role. If its the job youve been waiting for someone to hand you, we should talk.
How Youll Contribute
  • Set the standard and make it the default. Define Bolts product voice, terminology, and patterns for the moments that repeat: prompts, errors, empty states, permissions, billing, settings. Then put it where the work happens, in the design system, in components, in internal agents, so good copy holds up at the speed we ship.
  • Raise the bar on everyones words. Review writing from across the company and give feedback that improves peoples judgment, not only the sentence in front of you.
  • Own the content strategy. Bring a point of view on what we should say, when, and how much. Shape product direction from problem definition rather than copy-editing at the end.
  • Ship content-led features end to end. Feature onboarding, in-product education, the moments where a value prop has to land. Youre the design DRI: you scope it, design it in Figma or build it with agentic tools, and drive it through implementation without a product design partner.
  • Work across the whole lifecycle. Partner with Marketing and CX so that what we say before someone arrives, inside the product, and after they hit a problem all reinforce each other.
Qualifications
  • A portfolio of product content work with at least two examples where you can show the problem, your reasoning, what you rejected, and what changed after it shipped. Complex products, real scale. We care more about judgment than polish.
  • You can take a content-led feature from problem to shipped without a product designer. That means designing it in Figma, or building it with agentic tools, to a standard wed actually ship. If your process depends on someone else turning your words into screens, this role will frustrate us both.
  • Youve built a standard, a system, or a set of guidelines that other people actually used. Bonus points if youve watched one fail and can explain why.
  • You can give feedback that lands, including to people outside design who didnt ask for it and dont share your vocabulary, and to other writers as a peer rather than a manager.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills are required, as this role involves frequent collaboration with team members, stakeholders, and customers where English is the primary working language.
Bonus Points
  • Startup or small team experience. You are not just one of many!
  • Experience shaping AI tools, or writing for products where the interface is a conversation.
  • Experience writing for product, marketing and support content, or migrating knowledge between them.
  • Consumer product experience.
A Few Notes
  • You do not need a college degree to apply
  • You do not need to be located in the U.S. - we re remote-friendly
  • You do not need to meet every qualification listed above
